# THE ANNEX [italic]A break room for the people who clean, feed, guard and repair the parts of the Company that are not on the tour.[/italic]
Janitors. Cooks. Pump techs. Night guards. Orderlies. The ones who sign the confidentiality addendum without reading it because the bonus pays off a debt. We do not have clearance for what is behind the doors we open. We have keys to them. This board is for what you saw while you were doing your job.
[color=#E3D27A][bold]:: NEVER POST FROM A FACILITY TERMINAL :: NEVER POST FROM A FACILITY TERMINAL ::[/bold][/color]
## BREAK ROOM RULES - No facility names in thread titles. In the body, if you must. Sublevels and ring letters are fine. Every site has a sublevel three. - No staff names, no subject names. Subjects get the number on their door. That is what the Company calls them, and it is the only thing that will match a manifest. - Say your job. A guard and a cook see the same corridor differently, and we need both. - Nobody here is a scientist. If you are one, say so, and expect to be asked hard questions. - If you stop posting, we will not come looking. Leave a word with someone you trust.

## IF YOU ARE NEW HERE You are not imagining it. Most of what goes on behind the doors is boring: cultures, soil, paperwork. Some of it is not. The doors that matter are the ones with two locks, a feeding schedule taped to the outside, and a guard who will not look at the window.
The paperwork that sends things through those doors turns up at [netlink="wyleaks.deep" link="wyleaks.deep"]. The staff who stop answering turn up at [netlink="missing.deep" link="missing.deep"].
